native.status: Built journey-v3, user-approved September 30, 2026, extended by live Walkthrough and native file/conversation navigation
native.scope: native/ only; no authority over root CLI design docs or reference gallery
native.representation: Native APIs and AppKit points extend identity-only portable frontmatter. No fixed CSS colors, HTML/CSS previews, synthetic tonal ramps, or raster concept assets.

colorBindings.primary: NSColor.controlAccentColor: entry/open/send actions, folder symbols, and native state
colorBindings.text: NSColor.labelColor: primary prose, headings, approval, and base code
colorBindings.secondary: NSColor.secondaryLabelColor: supporting prose, metadata, activity, and comments
colorBindings.material: Clear source lists over NSVisualEffectView.sidebar with withinWindow blending
colorBindings.syntax: systemPurple keywords; systemRed strings/removals; systemGreen additions; systemBlue diff hunks
colorBindings.defaults: AppKit owns window grounds, controls, selection, focus, disabled and inactive state
colorBindings.walkthrough: systemOrange issue/approval symbols; systemRed failed instruction; controlAccentColor other stages; text and symbols preserve meaning

fontBindings.system: NSFont.systemFont; AppKit points; native control defaults retained
fontBindings.display: Welcome 32 semibold; other entry headings 30 semibold
fontBindings.headings: Conversation 21 semibold; approval 20 semibold; context 16 semibold; project 15 semibold
fontBindings.body: Entry 15/16 regular; conversation/composer 14 regular; workspace 14 semibold
fontBindings.rows: Conversation 13 regular/medium; transcript 12 semibold; activity 12 regular; Open File filename medium over smaller secondary path
fontBindings.evidence: NSFont.monospacedSystemFont 12 regular; exact tool identifier 11 regular
fontBindings.walkthrough: 16 semibold stage; 12 medium activity message; 12 regular selectable detail; 11 regular status/duration/exit/coverage captions
fontBindings.limitations: No bundled fonts or global tracking/line-height tokens; transcript is plain text

responsive.compact: Conversation hides context; Task context reveals a 300-point panel alongside center. Transcript/composer persist; revealing navigation hides context.
responsive.short: Alternate Code/Changes browser and preview; release browser height. File selection requires activation so arrow navigation keeps the browser visible. Walkthrough hides secondary stage explanation and evidence summary, retaining stage, activity and actions.

layoutPoints.captureQualification: Prior journey frames remain historical evidence. Walkthrough requested 720x480 was constrained by native minimum window size; actual compact frames are 720x500/504. Exact 480-point acceptance is not established. Navigation follow-up frames are 1312x731 and 720x500; evidence dimensions are not layout breakpoints.
layoutPoints.reading: Reflow rows, preserve earlier origin or follow within 35 points of bottom; physical selection/reading retention unverified

walkthrough.expandedRows: Grow with selectable detail and file links; scrolling table yields to native controls

native.shapesAndDepth: Native buttons, source lists, search fields, segments, SF Symbols, sidebar material, sheets and popovers. One 10-point NSBox composer radius; 20-point square transcript disclosure and native Walkthrough table disclosures. No custom shadow/gradient/texture or general radius scale.

motion.indicator: Native indeterminate Walkthrough spinner only for connected, visible running/cancelling work; hidden/minimized/offline/approval/terminal states stop it
motion.stageIcon: CATransition fade, 0.18 seconds, for visible stage changes; no percentage or fixed linear checklist
motion.reduceMotion: AppKit preference stops the indicator and removes the transition; stage text and symbol remain
motion.evidence: Fixture diagnostics cover live and stopped states including Reduce Motion; static captures do not certify timing or physical accessibility acceptance
motion.other: Native preparation/sign-in spinners remain; filter/draft/elapsed scheduling is not decorative motion

stateBoundaries.conversations: Negotiated durable isolated runtime context/history. Switching blocked for active/queued/uncertain/approval work; runtime refuses staged agent edits. Save current draft, invalidate pending navigation/inspection/activity, and hold composer noneditable until a fresh destination snapshot is confirmed. Adoption clears prior inspection/history controls and Walkthrough selection. Run details/output stay in the selected conversation. History never resumes execution.
stateBoundaries.drafts: Per-conversation drafts in bounded atomic workspace recovery; destination adoption restores its own text. Failed save prevents switching. Uncertain submission looked up by original ID, never replayed.
stateBoundaries.account: Private account process reuses existing OpenAI Codex OAuth/protected storage. Swift receives status/restricted browser URL/catalog availability, never credentials. Workspaces close before account change; disconnect removes local connection.
stateBoundaries.providerMigration: New dynamic-client/token-sharing contract remains separate; see JOURNEY-V3.md. No entitlement, billing or inference claim from connection/catalog status.
stateBoundaries.inspection: Read-only; browsing adds no context and filename results grant no read access. Conversation changes discard stale replies and clear inspector history. Lexical outline at most 100 declarations in displayed page; Git comparisons include earlier/external edits. Background refresh retains the preview until Reload and preserves recorded-history pages.
stateBoundaries.windows: Independent workspaces; four-window product target is not an enforced source cap
stateBoundaries.walkthrough: Negotiated walkthrough-v1; follow active/approval/cancelling work over queued work, or explicitly pin loaded history. Structured events, bounded retained activity/checkpoints and ordered merges preserve partial recorded work; restart marks unfinished work interrupted without replay. Coverage and load-retry UI expose limits; not a complete audit log.

navigation.filePicker: Modeless NSPanel child of the workspace, inheriting its appearance; conversation and Stop remain available. Scope/search precede a flexible result table; status, keyboard hint, Refresh and Open Preview follow. Local picker measurements are not global tokens.
navigation.scope: Open File searches filenames and paths, not file contents. Git scope names ignore rules; plain-folder scope names hidden/generated exclusions. Conversation search says Find on this page and filters loaded titles. Code filtering remains local to the folder.
navigation.states: Clear old selectable results while searching; explicit loading, no-match, partial-scan, overlong-query and failure copy. Refresh rebuilds results; failure offers Retry and Code browsing. Open Preview disabled without valid selection. Coverage/result limits remain visible.
navigation.resultRows: Native document symbol, medium system-font filename above smaller secondary path, middle truncation, full-path tooltip and native selection.
navigation.activation: Picker arrows select; Return, double-click or Open Preview opens read-only content. Code folder selection never opens: Return/double-click/Right enters; Left returns to parent. Code file selection previews when browser and preview coexist; short layouts require Return/double-click. Opening a path reveals its parent.
navigation.focus: Escape restores previous responder; clicking the conversation dismisses without reclaiming focus. Focus Composer (Cmd-L) dismisses the picker, selects compact Conversation, makes the workspace key and makes composer first responder. Background conversation completion does not activate an inactive workspace.
navigation.availability: File menu, Actions and context header expose Open File (Cmd-P) only with a ready runtime and file-search-v1; closing, conversation transition and attached sheets prevent opening.
navigation.input: NSSearchField marked-text composition retains native handling. Debouncing and request generations schedule work and reject stale results; no decorative motion.

review.dispositionScope: J3-F01 through J3-F04 and regressions attributable to their fix batch only; not full surface or release certification
review.provenance: verification.json and evidence.json carry build identity and capture origins; supplemental light disclosure states are separately recorded
review.fixtureScope: Synthetic conversation history/approval; packaged runtime file/diff reads and conversation switching. No OAuth or model task in UI fixtures.
review.reviewerScope: Static native captures and targeted source; reviewer did not rerun tests or interaction. No design detector ran.

walkthroughReview.diagnostics: Matching JSON for all eight captured states; actual wide 1440x731, compact 720x500, approval 720x504; exact 720x480 not certified
walkthroughReview.dispositionScope: Eight captured native states and targeted WalkthroughView/WalkthroughState/WorkspaceWindow/RuntimeClient integration source; not backend, full accessibility or release certification
walkthroughReview.fixtureScope: Scripted engine over production DesktopSession, database, protocol and native client; actual file reads. Real CLI scheduler callbacks tested separately. No provider, OAuth or approval command executed.
walkthroughReview.packagedRuntime: Actual bundled Node/CLI negotiated walkthrough-v1, preserved persisted activity metadata/paths and passed read-only file inspection; no provider request
walkthroughReview.reviewerScope: Native captures, JSON provenance and targeted native source; backend/engine not independently reviewed and tests not rerun. No native design detector ran.
unverified: Physical Reduce Motion and transition timing acceptance

navigationReview.diagnostics: Matching JSON for all nine captured states; actual wide 1312x731 and compact 720x500. Active native focus probe recorded workspaceKey=true and composerFocused=true with picker hidden before capture could alter focus.
resolved: composer-focus: Cmd-L dismisses picker, restores workspace key window and composer first responder
navigationReview.dispositionScope: Final narrow verdict covers the scored composer-focus fix and attributable regressions only. All nine refreshed captures valid; no attributable regressions observed. Earlier journey/Walkthrough reviews remain historical.

automatedEvidence.navigation: scoped search, compact preview, draft restoration, stale-history clearing and composer focus handoff passed

navigationReview.fixtureScope: Actual native app with explicitly scripted engine over production DesktopSession and inspection; raw native window captures including attached modeless picker. No generated UI imagery or provider invocation.
navigationReview.packagedRuntime: Bundled Node/CLI negotiated file-search-v1 and passed real filename search; foreign run details/output rejected and original history restored. No provider request.
navigationReview.reviewerScope: Native captures and targeted AppKit source; initial review of eight captures followed by nine refreshed captures for the scored correction. No web design detector ran.

narrative.overview:
Human–agent conversation leads this macOS workspace. A quiet native shell gives the conversation room to breathe, keeps its composer available, and places project navigation and read-only evidence within reach. System typography, semantic appearance, SF Symbols, and familiar AppKit controls provide the visual character.

This records the built translation of [journey-v3](../ui-prototypes/journey-v3/), approved for implementation on September 30, 2026: projects and conversations on the left, a dominant central conversation with a unified composer, and secondary Walkthrough / Changes / Code on the right. The live Walkthrough extends that system with inspectable activity and explicit follow-current or pinned-history selection. Native filename/path search and deliberate file activation connect intent to read-only evidence; conversation changes preserve separate drafts and clear stale inspection. The same native system carries preparation, welcome, browser sign-in, and the project library. Generated concepts remain references; no raster concept ships inside the app UI.

Swift/AppKit remains the implementation. [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md), [JOURNEY-V3.md](../docs/desktop/JOURNEY-V3.md), and the [Walkthrough contract](../docs/desktop/WALKTHROUGH.md) define product and runtime boundaries. This record applies only to native/. Identity-only portable frontmatter is extended by [.impeccable/design.json](.impeccable/design.json), which preserves native semantic bindings and point measurements without inventing CSS colors, web previews, or tonal ramps.
keyCharacteristics: A dominant human–agent conversation and persistent, unified native composer.
Projects and durable conversations on the left; secondary task context on the right.
Semantic light and dark appearance, system fonts, SF Symbols, and native chrome.
Readable activity and approval language with selectable technical evidence.
Explicit search scope, deliberate navigation, and a reliable return to the composer.
Runtime-owned execution, context, permissions, credentials, and task history.

rules.name: The Semantic Appearance Rule
rules.body: Preserve semantic colors and native materials in both appearances. Do not convert screenshots or system accents into fixed brand colors or synthetic tonal ramps.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Use system prose for intent, explanation, and decisions. Reserve monospaced text for code, exact paths, arguments, and identifiers.

rules.name: The Native Depth Rule
rules.body: Let AppKit render material, focus, control state, and modality. Native screenshot shadows and bezels do not establish application shadow or blur tokens.

dos: Do keep conversation dominant and its unified composer available beside secondary context.
Do preserve native semantic colors, fonts, controls, symbols, and window behavior.
Do fill the library's main pane, protect single-line dates, and let paths truncate.
Do use readable approval prose with exact selectable technical payloads and explicit decisions.
Do align conversation context, drafts, history, and admission with confirmed runtime state.
Do distinguish read-only evidence, Git baselines, review status, and verification limits.
Do preserve explicit follow-current versus pinned history and honest stage, coverage, and issue labels.
Do state each search scope and keep folder selection separate from opening; require file activation when preview replaces the browser.
Do restore the intended native key window and responder when returning to the composer.
donts: Don't replace Swift/AppKit with illustrative SwiftUI snippets, a web shell, or raster concepts.
Don't infer fixed palettes, tonal ramps, or a radius scale from native screenshots.
Don't promote the page outline to a language-server index or Git changes to exclusive run attribution.
Don't grant permission on default Return, replay uncertain submissions, or resume execution from history.
Don't equate connection/catalog status with subscription, billing, or inference entitlement.
Don't promote scoped reviews, synthetic fixtures, or local signing into release or accessibility certification.
